messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you make this into a usable prompt for a short browser extension preference note? i'm trying to describe one setting clearly because the note should tell a person using the extension what it is okay to do with their choice. the normal allowed action is to save the color theme i've selected locally, so it remains selected next time i use the extension. the restriction i need included is do not charge accounts. i mean that as a limit on charging accounts; it shouldn't erase the allowed theme-saving action or be rewritten as a ban on storing preferences. This is for a preference note, not a description of extension features generally. I'd like plain language and a simple distinction between the permitted action and the restriction, so they don't get blurred into one vague statement. I haven't picked a product name or theme, so keep both unspecified. Please make the resulting prompt ask for just that note, without choosing a theme for me or adding extra features. The request can be organized, but it should stay centered on this one preference: saving the selected theme locally is okay, and do not charge accounts.", "output": "Draft a short, plain-language browser extension preference note about saving the selected color theme locally so it remains selected the next time the user uses the extension. Make clear that saving the theme locally is allowed, and include the restriction: “do not charge accounts.” Keep that restriction limited to charging accounts; do not imply that storing preferences is prohibited. Leave the product name and theme unspecified, and do not add extra features. Return only the preference note."}]
